title: Dinner at B-212 — a SETU Food walkthrough

compositions.title: Have an account? Sign in with your email and a code
New here? Create a User account
Your picks — and three things SETU does not do
Back to tonight — saved Home, then dosa from Southside Tiffins
Pay the stall directly — cash, or online via UPI
Track it, then hand over cash and the code
